findings.message: domain.Employee.Deputy is orm.One but public.employees(manager_id) is not unique
findings.reason: nothing stops two rows from referencing the same one, so a to-one relation would silently pick whichever came back first
findings.fix: add a total unique constraint on public.employees(manager_id), or declare the field as orm.Many[Employee]

findings.reason: the table has more than one foreign key to itself
findings.fix: pin the constraint with orm:"fk:nodes_origin_fkey", and add side:local or side:remote if the direction is also ambiguous
